description: News article overlaid by a fake human-verification box that, after a click, silently copies a PowerShell command and tells the reader to paste it into Win+R.
rationale: A real CAPTCHA never asks the user to open the Run dialog and paste clipboard content; the copied text is a hidden remote-script command disguised as a verification code.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
